Και σηκώθηκε μεγάλη θύελλα ανέμου, και τα κύματα χτυπούσαν το πλοίο, ώστε αυτό γέμισε ήδη νερό. Και εκείνος ήταν στο πίσω μέρος του πλοίου, κοιμώμενος πάνω σε μαξιλάρι· και τον ξυπνούν και του λένε· Διδάσκαλε, δεν σε νοιάζει ότι χανόμαστε; Και σηκώθηκε, και επιτίμησε τον άνεμο, και είπε στη θάλασσα· Σιγά, ησύχασέ. Και ο άνεμος έπαυσε, και έγινε μεγάλη γαλήνη. Και τους είπε· Γιατί φοβάστε έτσι; Πώς δεν έχετε πίστη; Και φοβήθηκαν σφόδρα, και είπαν ο ένας στον άλλον· Τι άνθρωπος είναι αυτός, που και ο άνεμος και η θάλασσα υπακούν σ’ αυτόν; Μάρκος 4:37-41

Πολλές φορές έχω διαβάσει αυτή την περικοπή και αναρωτήθηκα τι πρέπει να αντλήσουμε από αυτήν. Φαίνεται να είναι μια ιστορία που γεννά περισσότερα ερωτήματα απ’ όσα λύνει. Συχνά μας αρέσει να σκεφτόμαστε τον Ιησού ως την προσωποποιημένη, σχεσιακή μορφή της Θεότητος· ένα είδος διαμεσολαβητή ανάμεσά μας και του Παντοδύναμου Θεού. Αλλά εδώ, στην γραφική μας περικοπή, η συμπεριφορά Του είναι σχεδόν ασύλληπτη με ανθρώπινους όρους. Πώς μπορούσε ο Χριστός να κοιμάται σε τέτοια θύελλα, πολύ περισσότερο μέσα σ’ ένα σκάφος που γέμιζε νερό; Μπορούμε να πιστέψουμε ότι είναι Κύριος του ανέμου και των θαλασσών, και αυτοί πρέπει να υποκλιθούν στη διαταγή Του, αλλά μήπως περιμένει από εμάς να κάνουμε το ίδιο; Θα απαιτούσε ο συμπονετικός μας Χριστός να είμαστε ήρεμοι και ατρόμητοι σε τέτοιες απελπιστικές συνθήκες; Είναι κάθε έκφραση φόβου καρπός της έλλειψης πίστης μας; Αυτά τα διαπεραστικά ερωτήματα είναι ταραχώδη, διότι όλοι θα ελπίζαμε ότι η πίστη μας σε Αυτόν είναι αρκετά δυνατή για να εξασφαλίσει τη σωτηρία μας, κι όμως η εμπειρία μας έχει διδάξει ότι ο δικός μας περίπατος μέσα από τα ταραχώδη βοσκοτόπια της ζωής παρήγαγε τίποτε περισσότερο ευγενές από το τρομερό βογγητό των μαθητών.

Γιατί φοβάστε έτσι; Πώς δεν έχετε πίστη; Τα ερωτήματα μοιάζουν σχεδόν αταίριαστα όταν προέρχονται από τον Σωτήρα μας, σχεδόν σαν να μην είναι τόσο υπομονετικός και μακρόθυμος όσο ελπίζαμε. Αλλά ο Χριστός έχει θέσει μια οριστική προσδοκία στους μαθητές Του που δεν είναι πέρα από την επίτευξή τους. Τους καλούσε άραγε να επιτιμηθούν στη θύελλα οι ίδιοι; Έπρεπε να τον είχαν ξυπνήσει νωρίτερα; Περίμενε να συνεχίσουν να κωπηλατούν ήσυχα με βέβαιη εμπιστοσύνη; Η Γραφή εδώ μας δίνει λίγες απαντήσεις, αλλά ξέρουμε ότι υπάρχει ένα διαρκές μάθημα εδώ σχετικά με τον φόβο και την πίστη.

Οι καταιγίδες είναι κοινό μέρος της ζωής, και κανένα σοβαρό δίλημμα δεν είναι ευχάριστο. Όταν ο Παύλος ταξίδευε προς τη Ρώμη, βίωσαν καιρό …όταν ούτε ήλιος ούτε αστέρια πολλές μέρες φάνηκαν, και μεγάλη ταραχή μάς έπεσε· και κάθε ελπίδα για σωτηρία μάς ελήφθη – Πράξεις 27:20. Στο μέσον μιας σκοτεινής και απελπισμένης κατάστασης υπάρχει μια καμπάνα που συνεχίζει να χτυπά καθαρά και φωτεινά: Υπάρχει ειρήνη που μπορεί να γίνει κατανοητή ακόμα και στις πιο φρικτές περιστάσεις. Ο Παύλος είχε περάσει μια επισφαλή …νύκτα και ημέρα ήμουν στο βάθος της θαλάσσης – Β΄ Κορινθίους 11:25, κι όμως δεν απαίτησε από τον άνεμο και τη θάλασσα να υποταχθούν στην εξουσία του. Αντίθετα, δηλώνει ότι μέσα στη θύελλα …παραστάθηκε προς εμέ εκείνην τη νύκτα άγγελος Θεού, του οποίου είμαι εγώ και τον οποίον υπηρετώ, λέγων· Μη φοβού· Παύλε… – Πράξεις 27:23-24. Αυτή είναι μια σκηνή παρόμοια με τον κίνδυνο που υπέφεραν οι μαθητές (στο κείμενό μας), κι όμως βλέπουμε διαφορετικό αποτέλεσμα. Ο Παύλος παρηγορήθηκε και επαινέθηκε ενώ οι μαθητές δέχθηκαν επιπλήξη.

Καθώς ταλαντεύονταν στα σαγόνια ενός πιθανoύ υγρού τάφου, οι μαθητές φώναξαν: …Διδάσκαλε, δεν σε νοιάζει ότι χανόμαστε; – Μάρκος 4:38. Πόσο φυσικό είναι για όλους μας να φορτώνουμε την απογοήτευσή μας και την ευθύνη στον άλλον. Να σκεφτόμαστε ότι κάποιος αδιάφορος άνθρωπος αποφεύγει την ευθύνη του είναι πολύ αποθαρρυντικό. Παρομοίως …ο κυβερνήτης του πλοίου ήρθε προς αυτόν [τον Ιωνά], και του είπε· Τι κάνεις, υπνώτη; Σήκω, επίκλησε τον Θεόν σου· μήπως σκεφθή ο Θεός περί ημών, και να μη απολεσθώμεν – Ιωνάς 1:6.

Υπάρχει μια αιχμή στην επιπλήξη του κυβερνήτη του πλοίου πολύ όμοια με την αντίδραση των μαθητών στον κοιμώμενο Ιησού. Ο Χριστός δεν χαίρεται να επιτρέπει τη θλίψη να μας επισκέπτεται, αλλά φαίνεται πως δεν υπάρχει άλλο πραγματικό μέσο χάριτος με το οποίο η ειρήνη Του να μπορέσει να πλημμυρίσει τις ψυχές μας. Εάν πρώτα δεν υπάρχει κοιλάδα, πώς θα εκτιμήσουμε την κορυφή του βουνού; Εάν δεν υπάρχουν αγκάθια, πώς θα απολαύσουμε το τριαντάφυλλο; Εάν πρώτα δεν υπάρχει θύελλα, πώς θα εκτιμήσουμε την ηρεμία; Ο Παύλος υπέφερε την ίδια απελπισία …συμπιεσμένοι πέραν των δυνάμεων, ώστε απελπισθήκαμε και για τη ζωή – Β΄ Κορινθίους 1:8. Όμως μέσα του είχε έναν οραματικό άγκυρα για την ψυχή του.

Διότι διατάσσει και σηκώνει ο άνεμος της θύελλας τα κύματα αυτού· εκείνα ανεβαίνουν εις τους ουρανούς, και κατεβαίνουν εις τα βάθη· την ψυχήν τους λιώνει η θλίψις· πλανώνται και κλυδωνίζονται σαν μέθυσοι, και χάνονται ηγία· τότε φωνάζουσιν προς Κύριον εν τη θλίψει αυτών, και εκφέρει αυτούς εκ της θλίψεως αυτών· ποιεί τη θύελλαν εις γαλήνην, και τα κύματα αυτής σιγάνονται· τότε χαίρονται διότι εγαλήνευσαν· και φέρει αυτούς εις το επιθυμητόν λιμένα αυτών – Ψαλμός 107:25-30.

Το Επιθυμητό Λιμάνι…

Κάπως, έχουμε υιοθετήσει την ιδέα ότι το επιθυμητό λιμάνι της ανάπαυσης είναι μια επίγειος ευφορική ουτοπία χωρίς καμία θύελλα. Ο κυβερνήτης που είχε το καθήκον να οδηγήσει το σκάφος προς τη Ρώμη σκέφτηκε ότι …το λιμάνι δεν ήταν κατάλληλο για χειμώνα … υποθέτοντες ότι είχαν επιτύχει τον σκοπό τους… – Πράξεις 27:12-13, έτσι απέπλευσε στο πρώτο άγγιγμα έγκρισης από τον ήπιο νότιο άνεμο. Αλλά το λιμάνι που προωθεί ο Χριστός είναι ένα καταφύγιο που είναι ελεύθερο από αναστατωμένο φόβο και ραγδαία πίστη. Αυτή είναι μια ειρήνη … που δεν όπως ο κόσμος δίνει, εγώ δίνω σε εσάς· μη ταράσσεται η καρδιά σας, μη φοβείσθε – Ιωάννης 14:27. Αυτή η ανάπαυση είναι δική μας, απλώς πλέοντας με τον Χριστό και εμπιστευόμενοι Αυτόν να μας καθοδηγήσει μέσα από κάθε θύελλα.

Οι επίμονες θύελλες της αντίξοης συνθήκης μπορούν να προκύψουν χωρίς προειδοποίηση τόσο γρήγορα όσο …ένας θυελλώδης άνεμος, καλούμενος Ευροκλύδων – Πράξεις 27:14. Αυτοί οι θυελλώδεις άνεμοι φέρουν μια αξιοθαύμαστη τολμηρότητα να κλονίσουν οποιαδήποτε σχέση. Το να νιώθουμε ένταση και επαγρύπνηση μέσα σε στρεσογόνες καταστάσεις είναι απλώς ανθρώπινη φύση. Ο κεντρικός μας ενδοκρινής αδένας εκλύει μια ισχυρή ορμόνη που ονομάζεται αδρεναλίνη στο σύστημά μας, οι μύες μας τεντώνονται, ο νους μας εστιάζει, ώστε να είμαστε διεγερμένοι και έτοιμοι για πάλη ή φυγή. Αυτό δεν είναι αναγκαστικά άγχος αλλά μια φυσική αντίδραση. Ως άνθρωποι, έχουμε μια θεία ικανότητα να λογικευόμαστε στο μέσον ακραίου πάθους και πίεσης. Οι μαθητές δεν ήξεραν τι θα έκανε ο Ιησούς. Ήξεραν μόνο ότι αυτή η κατάσταση είχε ξεφύγει από τον έλεγχο. Εδώ έκαναν το μεγάλο λάθος τους. Ο Χριστός ήξερε Ποιος είχε τον έλεγχο. Ο Παύλος ήξερε Ποιος είχε τον έλεγχο. Ακόμη και ο Ιωνάς ήξερε γιατί είχε προκύψει η θύελλα. Η πίστη μας είναι καταδικασμένη να αποτύχει όταν το άγχος κλιμακώνεται, και νομίζουμε ότι πρέπει να ελέγξουμε τις μανιασμένες δοκιμασίες γύρω μας. Μπορεί να έχουμε έναν αξιοπρεπή σκοπό και ένα ειλικρινές καρδιά και παρ’ όλα αυτά να βρούμε την τρεμουλιαστή μας πίστη να καταρρέει. Θαυμαζόμαστε λανθασμένα ότι ο Θεός κάθεται στους ουρανούς και δεν κάνει τίποτε. Πίστεις μας υψώνουν τις προσευχές μας, αλλά οι ουρανοί φαίνονται αλαζονικά σιωπηλοί. Αυτό θα το περίμενε κανείς από λατρευτές του Βάαλ, του Βούδα και από αποστρεφόμενους. Αλλά δεν πρέπει να συμβεί σε ανθρώπους με ισχυρές πεποιθήσεις—ανθρώπους που έχουν γεννηθεί ξανά, παρακολουθούν κανονικά την εκκλησία, διαβάζουν την Αγία Γραφή τους και προσεύχονται καθημερινά. Πρέπει να επανεξετάσουμε ότι ο Θεός δεν ανησυχεί τόσο για την περιβαλλοντική μας ειρήνη, όσο για το να φθάσει η εσωτερική μας ψυχή ασφαλής και ακέραια στο λιμάνι της ανάπαυσής Του.

Όταν είμαστε χαρούμενοι, με χαρά διεκδικούμε εκείνη την ανάπαυση, παρόλο που δεν έχουμε αίσθηση ότι τον έχουμε πραγματικά ανάγκη. Οι εισβολές Του στη ζωή μας συχνά μοιάζουν σαν παρεμβολές. Αλλά όταν οι καιροί γίνουν απελπιστικοί και έχουμε εξαντλήσει όλους τους πόρους μας, ακουμπάμε βαριά πάνω Του. Σε εκείνη τη βασανιστική ώρα, συχνά δοκιμάζει την ειλικρίνειά μας και δεν μας προσφέρει τίποτα… τίποτα παρά σιωπή. Ο Χριστός, κοιμώμενος στο σκάφος μας. Κοιμάται… ακριβώς όταν τον χρειαζόμαστε περισσότερο. Και τότε το ερώτημα, Γιατί φοβάστε έτσι; Πώς δεν έχετε πίστη; Ειλικρινά, αυτό μου φαίνεται δύσκολο—ακόμη και σκληρό—και εντελώς έξω από τον χαρακτήρα που κανονικά θα περίμενα από τον Ιησού. Αλλά το ερώτημα πρέπει να απαντηθεί, διότι είναι αναγκαίο αν επιθυμούμε να εισέλθουμε στο λιμάνι της ανάπαυσής Του. Οι άνεμοι υπακούουν σ’ Αυτόν, αλλά δεν υπακούουν σε εμάς… ή μήπως ναι; Προφανώς δεν μπορούμε να ελέγξουμε τον καιρό, το περιβάλλον μας, τις καταστάσεις ή τους ανθρώπους γύρω μας. Ωστόσο αυτά τα εξωτερικά δεν είναι η ρίζα της ανησυχίας μας. Είναι οι δικές μας ελαττωματικές προαίσθησεις που χτυπούν την ψυχή μας και μας εμποδίζουν να εισέλθουμε στην πύλη της ειρήνης. Οι άνεμοι που μαστιγώνουν το σκάφος μας σε φοβισμένη μανία δεν κινούνται από έξω αλλά απελευθερώνονται από μέσα. Το άγχος αυτό ταξιδεύει πάνω στα κύματα της απιστίας, ενώ ο Χριστός συνεχίζει στον θεϊκό Του ύπνο, περιμένοντας μέχρι να αναγνωρίσουμε την πηγή του άγχους μας και να φωνάξουμε με πίστη. Αυτοί οι τέσσερις ισχυροί άνεμοι ξυπνάνε με την ελάχιστη πρόκληση όταν είμαστε…

…Φυλάσσοντας το Πρόσωπό μας

Εάν είμαστε υγιείς, και αν τα πράγματα πάνε καλά στην οικογένεια και τα οικονομικά μας, μπορεί να έχουμε την τάση να ερμηνεύουμε λάθος τις περιστάσεις μας. Είναι λάθος να πιστεύουμε ότι η εύκολη πλεύση είναι δείγμα της εύνοιας του Θεού, και ότι η δοκιμασία είναι σημάδι της δυσαρέσκειάς Του. Όλα τα καλά και τέλεια δώρα προέρχονται από τον Θεό, αλλά μια εξουθενωτική θύελλα μπορεί επίσης να εμπίπτει σε αυτή την κατηγορία. Το προσωπικό μας περιβάλλον είναι προσωρινό ενώ η ψυχή μας είναι αιώνια. Ο Θεός συχνά θα ξοδέψει τις προσωπικές μας ανέσεις προκειμένου να διευρύνει την πίστη μας. Αλλά μεγάλος φόβος αναδύεται όταν το πρόσωπό μας υποβαθμίζεται. Πολλές από τις φοβίες μας προκύπτουν απουσία πραγματικού κινδύνου.

  1. Ο ακροφοβικός φοβάται τα ύψη και φοβάται ότι θα πέσει από οποιαδήποτε εξέδρα, παρότι είναι ασφαλής και καλά προστατευμένη. Ακόμη κι αν αμέτρητοι άλλοι έχουν σταθεί επιτυχώς εκεί, αυτός είναι δυστυχώς παγιδευμένος σε αυτόν τον φόβο, όχι επειδή βρίσκεται σε κίνδυνο, αλλά επειδή έχει υπερεκτιμήσει κατά πολύ την πιθανότητα πτώσης και αρνείται να δεχθεί την αλήθεια.
  2. Ο ζωοφοβικός ζει με τον φόβο των ζώων, δημιουργώντας εικόνες στο μυαλό του ότι θα ξιφολογηθεί μέχρι θανάτου ή θα εκσπλαχνιστεί.
  3. Ο κλειστοφοβικός φοβάται μικρούς, στενούς χώρους, ενώ ο αγοραφοβικός φοβάται ανοικτούς χώρους.
  4. Η αραχιβουτυροφοβία είναι ο φόβος να κολλήσει βούτυρο φυστικοβούτυρου στον ουρανίσκο του στόματος σας.

Εμπρός στον φόβο του, ο φοβικός μπορεί να νιώσει καρδιακό παλμό, βαρύ αναπνευστικό ρυθμό, ξηροστομία, εφίδρωση, ζάλη ή ελαφρότητα. Έτσι οι φοβίες τους γίνονται πραγματικές γι’ αυτούς. Ενώ οι περισσότεροι θα δικαιολογήσουν το προσωπικό τους σφάλμα, η αλήθεια παραμένει ότι αυτό το άγχος είναι αβάσιμο. Όταν δικαιολογούμε και περιποιούμαστε την διατήρηση του προσώπου μας, ο φόβος είναι αναπόφευκτος. Οι μαθητές φοβήθηκαν ότι χάνουν τη ζωή τους, και ο Χριστός τους ρώτησε γιατί. Μήπως δεν είναι καλύτερο …να αποχωριστούμε, και να είμαστε με τον Χριστό· που είναι πολύ καλύτερο – Φιλιππησίους 1:23. Εάν μπορούμε να εμπιστευθούμε τον Χριστό με τη ζωή μας, δεν μπορούμε να Τον εμπιστευθούμε και με το θάνατό μας;

Διότι όστις θέλει τη ζωή του να σώσει, θα την απωλέσει· και όστις απωλέσει τη ζωή του διά εμέ και το Ευαγγέλιο, θα τη σώσει – Μάρκος 8:35.

…Προστατεύοντας την Περιουσία μας

Εξωτερικά, η ζωή του Χριστού ήταν μία από τις πιο ταραγμένες ζωές που έχουν ποτέ ζήσει. Οι αλεπούδες έχουν τις φωλιές τους και τα πουλιά έχουν τις φωλιές τους, ενώ Αυτός έθεσε το μαξιλάρι Του στο πίσω μέρος ενός λικνιστού σκάφους που βογκούσε κάτω από τη θύελλα και το ανακάτεμα των αδιάκοπων κυμάτων που έσπαζαν πάνω του. Αλλά το εσωτερικό Του καταφύγιο ήταν μια θάλασσα σαν γυαλί. Αυτό οφειλόταν εν μέρει στο γεγονός ότι δεν είχε περιουσία να προστατεύσει. Ακόμη και το σκάφος ήταν δανεικό. «Πολύ νόμισμα, πολλή φροντίδα» λέει το αρχαίο ρητό, και το άγχος αυξάνεται όταν πέφτει ο πλούτος. Και είπε κάποιος εκ του όχλου προς αυτόν· Διδάσκαλε, πες στο αδελφό μου να μοιράσει μαζί μου την κληρονομιά – Λουκάς 12:13. Ο Ιησούς αρνήθηκε να πάρει το μέρος του. Αντίθετα, μίλησε στην πλεονεξία της καρδιάς που προκάλεσε το άγχος. Εάν ο Χριστός μας δώσει πλούτο, δεν χρειαζόμαστε να νιώθουμε ένοχοι. Εάν τον πάρει, δεν χρειάζεται να έχουμε άγχος. Μέσα στη θύελλα μας παροτρύνει …να είσθε θαρραλέοι· διότι δεν θα χαθή η ζωή κανενός εξ υμών, παρά μόνο το πλοίον – Πράξεις 27:22. Αυτό υπηρέτησε ως θεραπευτικό βάλσαμο στους κακοτράχαλους ναυτικούς, αλλά για εκείνους που τείνουν να προστατεύουν την περιουσία τους είναι μια δυσάρεστη ιστορία. Όταν ο πλούσιος νέος άρχοντας του προσφέρθηκε σωτηρία με αντάλλαγμα τη συλλογή των επίγειων αντικειμένων του, …απήλθε λυπημένος· διότι είχε πολλά υπάρχοντα – Ματθαίος 19:22. Εμείς που ανησυχούμε για την απώλεια του πλούτου μας δεν είμαστε λιγότερο ανόητοι.

…Τελειοποιώντας το Σχέδιό μας

Θέτουμε μια πορεία. Ίσως αλλάζουμε δουλειά, μπαίνουμε σε μια σχέση ή ξεκινούμε κάποιο νέο δρόμο διακονίας. Έχουμε ξεκινήσει με πίστη και πριν το καταλάβουμε, παλεύουμε. Οι άνεμοι και τα κύματα της καθημερινής ζωής φαίνεται να δουλεύουν εναντίον μας. Έχουμε προσδοκίες που δεν ικανοποιούνται και φαίνεται ότι ο Χριστός δεν κάνει το μέρος Του. Δεν είναι ο Χριστός, αλλά η προσδοκία μας που είναι η αιτία του άγχους μας. Περιμένουμε πολλά από τις επενδύσεις μας και είναι αποθαρρυντικό να βλέπουμε τις προσπάθειές μας να πάνε χαμένες. Ο σφυγμός της Μάρθας επιτάχυνε από την έλλειψη βοήθειας που λάμβανε στην κουζίνα. Η απογοήτευσή της ανέβηκε ενώ το καλά προγραμματισμένο γεύμα της έμενε ατελές. Η παράπονή της δεν είναι λιγότερο κατηγορητική από αυτή των μαθητών καθώς κωπηλατούσαν στη θάλασσα. …Κύριε, δεν νοιάζεσαι ότι η αδελφή μου με αφήνει μοναχή να υπηρετώ; Πες της λοιπόν να μοιραστεί μαζί μου – Λουκάς 10:40. Το άγχος της δεν προκλήθηκε από την αμέλεια της Μαρίας ούτε από την αδιαφορία του Χριστού. Η αδελφή της είχε αγκυροβολήσει στο λιμάνι της ανάπαυσης ενώ η Μάρθα πάλευε με τα ταραγμένα συναισθήματα μέσα στην καρδιά της. Έτσι και ο τελειομανής δημιουργεί τη δική του θύελλα όταν το άπιαστο όραμά του υστερεί των προσδοκιών του. Αλλά ο Χριστός ενδιαφέρεται περισσότερο για τις πιστές καρδιές παρά για τα σκάφη γεμάτα νερό.

…Ευχαριστώντας όλους τους Ανθρώπους

Οι Γραφές μας έχουν διδάξει καλά να αγαπάμε τον πλησίον όπως τον εαυτό μας, αλλά αυτό δεν συνεπάγεται ότι πρέπει να παλεύουμε και να επιδιώκουμε την έγκρισή τους. Είναι υπέροχο να σε συμπαθούν. Είναι επώδυνο να σε απορρίπτουν. Έτσι πολλές ψυχές περνούν τις εγρήγορές τους αναζητώντας την έγκριση των άλλων. Πρέπει να ντύνονται όπως, να ενεργούν όπως, να μιλούν όπως και να ζουν όπως οι συνομήλικοί τους. Αυτοί ζουν μια ζωή γεμάτη με στρεσογόνα κύματα άγχους. Μια καταιγίδα «τι θα γίνει αν» φθάνει με κάθε νέα γνωριμία. Δεν υπάρχει πλοίο πιο εύθραυστο από μια σχέση. Όσο μεγάλη θυσία κι αν κάνουμε για να αγαπηθούμε, τελικά θα συναντήσουμε μια απογοητευτική θύελλα που μας ρουφάει στα βάθη της απελπισίας. Όταν οι καλύτερες προσπάθειές μας αποτυγχάνουν και οι καλύτεροι φίλοι μας εκτροχιάζονται, πρέπει να φέρουμε το χτυπημένο σκάφος μας στο λιμάνι της ανάπαυσης. Ενοχλητικές, άτυχες, δυσάρεστες και ενοχλητικές σχέσεις θα υπάρχουν πάντα. Κάνουμε πολύ καλύτερα να δικαιολογούμε τη κακή συμπεριφορά των άλλων παρά τη δική μας. Όταν μπορούμε να επιπλήξουμε τους ανέμους που αναφύονται μέσα στο νου μας, αμέσως θα βρεθούμε στο επιθυμητό λιμάνι.

Μένει λοιπόν ανάπαυσις λαού του Θεού. Διότι όστις εισήλθεν εις την ανάπαυσιν αυτού, και αυτός παύει από τα έργα αυτού, καθώς ο Θεός από των ιδίων· ας κοπιώμεν λοιπόν, ώστε να εισέλθωμεν εις εκείνην την ανάπαυσιν… – Εβραίους 4:9-11.

“Why don’t we have a cure for cancer yet?” My patient asked me.

I shrugged. “There are lots of different kinds of cancer,” I said. “For some, there are cures, while for others we are still learning how best to treat them.”

“I think,” my patient said with the confidence that he was supposedly sharing a top-secret theory. “I think there actually is a cure for cancer, but the drug companies just don’t want us to know about it.”

I shook my head. “I think we are doing the best we can,” I told him. “We’ve come a long way when it comes to treatment of cancer, but we still have a long way to go.”

Cancer is a scary illness. One Christian man told me that he wasn’t afraid of dying, but if he had a choice, he would choose almost any other way to go than to die of cancer.

More than that, it is something that seems mysterious. More people seem to be getting it, yet no one really knows why.

In this article, I would like to take some time to explore what cancer is, and to discuss cancer screening tests. In the second part (in the next issue) Lord willing, I will discuss some of the treatments available for cancers.

I will mention here that I am a family doctor. I have cared for many patients with cancer, but I am certainly not an oncologist, nor do I know everything about cancer. What I understand, I am willing to share.

What is Cancer?

As with many things, we can trace the beginnings of cancer back to the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. We know that God created humans perfectly. As originally created, not only did they not have cancer, but they also would not have gotten it either.

In order to understand what cancer is, we need to understand how normal tissue and cells behave.

Normal cells live for a period of time and then die. This process is called apoptosis. It makes certain that there is a constant turnover of cells. It also prevents one type of cell from getting “out of line” and beginning to grow in a place where it doesn’t belong.

Every time our cells divide, they copy their DNA into the daughter cells. Usually this happens without error, but occasionally there is an error in the copy process. We call these errors mutations.

Cancer cells are cells that have lost the normal brakes on their behavior. Because of mutations in their DNA, they no longer have a limited life span, nor do they observe the limits of where they belong within the body. Instead, they begin to encroach on surrounding tissues, pulling in additional blood supply and nutrients in the process.

Cancer cells can enlarge locally, or they can spread through the lymphatic system or circulatory system to distant parts of the body. When cancer cells end up in other locations than where they originated, we call it metastases.

The type of cancer is determined by the type of cell that is multiplying out of control. Doctors don’t generally talk about “skin cancer,” even though there are cancers that originate in skin cells. Instead, they classify these cancers into basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma—each one referring to a different kind of skin cell. Each one of these skin cancers acts differently. Basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma get bigger in a local area and seldom spread elsewhere, while melanoma is very prone to spreading to other parts of the body.

Additionally, how a cancer responds to treatment is going to be based on the type of cell that it comes from, not simply the organ where it originates.

Causes of Mutations…

We do not know how common cancer was in the days before the flood. I would speculate that it was fairly rare.

We know that before the flood, men lived to be very old—often into their 900s. Mutations must have been rare. Their DNA was closer to the original genetic specimen of mankind (and thus, to perfection) than ours is in the 21st century (AD) Therefore, the chance of genes mutating and abnormal genes popping up was much less than it is now.

…Environmental Factors

Beyond that, something must have happened around the time of the flood that increased the rate of mutations. Perhaps there was an increase in radiation levels. Maybe there were genetic changes that gradually caused cancer to show up.

Cancer is not mentioned in the Bible, although it is possible that Hezekiah’s “boil” could have been some kind of cancerous growth. It is also possible that some of the diseases that affected the Philistines when the ark of the covenant was in their land were cancerous tumors.

People began dying at younger ages after the flood and by soon after the time of Abraham, they were seldom living much past their one hundredth year.

Today, we know that things which damage a cell’s copying mechanism and its DNA increase the risk of cancer. The most well-known of these is radiation.

After the atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, survivors were noted to have significant increases in certain kinds of cancer. Leukemia (cancer of the blood) was the most common type of cancer, followed by cancer of stomach, lung, liver, and breast.

Radiation isn’t something that most people deal with on a regular basis. However, if you work in an x-ray department or if you needed to have radiation to treat some type of cancer, it is possible that you have been exposed to much higher levels of radiation than the general public.

There are plenty of other things that are associated with increases in cancers. Exposure to ultraviolet light increases the risk of skin cancer and is a big reason why doctors recommend sunscreen and protective clothing while enjoying the sunshine to limit ultraviolet exposure.

Finally, there are plenty of chemicals that are present in different types of work that can increase the risk of cancer.

…Unhealthy Foods

Foods that are high in nitrites increase the risk of intestinal cancers. Nitrites are typically present in smoked and cured meats. So, to be healthy, people should limit their intake of these foods to none or at the very least, a very limited percentage of the overall diet.

…Certain Prior Diseases

Another thing to mention is that certain types of infections can increase the risk of cancer. Epstein Barr virus, which causes infectious mononucleosis, has been associated with certain kinds of lymphoma. Hepatitis B and C increase the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer). And Helicobacter pylori infections in the stomach are associated with stomach cancers.

It is important to remember that just because someone has had one of these viruses it will not necessarily cause them to get cancer from that infection. Rather, it simply increases the risk that the person infected will get cancer at some point in the future.

…Unhealthy Habits

One last thing to mention is that certain toxins dramatically increase the risk of cancer. An obvious one is tobacco use, which strongly increases the risk of lung cancer, throat cancer, and even bladder cancer. Alcohol is another risk factor. Alcohol increases the risk of mouth and throat cancers, gastrointestinal cancers, and liver cancer. There really isn’t a safe amount of exposure to either of these toxic agents, but certainly the higher the level of exposure, the worse it is.

Screening for Cancer

There are many tests available that claim to be able to screen for a variety of cancers. Most of them are at least a little effective at identifying cancers at an early stage. However, there are a few problems with some of them which indicate that a certain test is ineffective at truly helping with the screening process.

A good place to start is to simply think about what a perfect screening test would look like. This will help us to see where tests might be beneficial or not.

A perfect screening test is going to have a number of features. First, it will have no false positive or false negative results. In other words, everyone who tests positive with the test will have cancer and those who test negative will not have cancer. Next, the test will identify the cancer at a point early enough in its development that it is easy to treat. The test will be cheap and minimally invasive, and it will require minimal exposure to radiation.

Unfortunately, no test that we currently do for screening totally meets these criteria.

For one thing, many tests produce both false positive and negative tests. These are both problems. The issue with a false negative test is obvious—it leads to someone thinking they don’t have cancer when they really do. A false positive test on the other hand leads to higher anxiety levels along with the cost and dangers from whatever ongoing testing is necessary to let a patient know that they don’t really have cancer.

An example of a bad test, in this respect, is the CEA-125. CEA-125 is a chemical that is made by some types of cancer. Oncologists use this level to track a patient’s response to chemotherapy.

It would make sense that you could use this as a screening test for these cancers, but it simply doesn’t work. Many people have elevated CEA levels, even though they don’t have cancer and on the other side, plenty of GI (gastrointestinal) cancers don’t make this chemical at all. Testing lots of people with CEA-125 testing will lead to more scans and biopsies, but it is doubtful if it would have a significant impact on death rates from cancer.

Another issue has to do with a particular cancer itself. In order for a test to be helpful, the cancer needs to have a long progression through precancerous stages until finally it develops into full-blown cancer.

An example is colon cancer. Most people who develop colon cancer have precancerous polyps several years before they get the cancer. This is why colonoscopies can be effective at preventing the progression to colon cancer.

If a patient has a colonoscopy, the doctor can detect the presence of polyps. More than that, he can remove the polyps through the scope, hopefully stopping the progression to cancer.

One last, related point is that there needs to be some benefit to early detection of cancer. If a new test can detect cancer six months earlier than existing tests, people will live an average of six months longer with the cancer than before, even if nothing else changes.

The question is whether diagnosing the cancer earlier leads to more effective treatment. Can you take it out before it spreads to the lymph glands and thereby completely avoid the need for chemotherapy?

If treatment and response rates are the same regardless of the stage at which you diagnose a cancer, then screening doesn’t really make sense.

The United States Preventive Services Task Force is a volunteer panel of experts that have reviewed the literature on a variety of tests. Based on the studies that have been conducted regarding the available tests, they make recommendations about the various tests and how often to use them.

This panel tends to be more conservative in their recommendations than many cancer societies. For instance, they recommend every other year for the use of mammograms for women between the ages of 50 and 75, as compared to the yearly screening recommended by other groups.

With each recommendation they give a grade of how good the studies are which support that specific recommendation, along with links for those studies. Their recommendations are well researched. This is helpful for low-risk people trying to decide what testing to do. If someone has a high risk because of family history or exposures, their recommendations are less helpful.

Cancer Challenges

People often discuss cancer as though it was a single entity. As before mentioned, cancer is not just one thing. Skin cancer behaves differently from lymphoma, which in turn behaves differently from sarcomas. The chance that there will ever be a single treatment for all cancer—the “Cure for Cancer” which people talk about, is unlikely.

An even bigger challenge when dealing with cancer cells is that they are very similar to our normal cells. Basically, we are trying to poison the cancer just a little more than the rest of our normal tissues. There are a number of different treatments that are currently available. In Part 2, we will address some of the different options available today and some others that may become available in the future.

Final Thoughts

There are a few things that come to mind when contemplating the subject of cancer.

We do not need to live in fear or make choices out of fear. Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness –Isaiah 41:10.

I don’t think that we should fatalistically allow anything to happen that might, simply because it is “God’s will.” We need to make wise choices, then having done so, we should not live in a state of anxiety.

Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things. But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof –Matthew 6:31-34.

Finally, if we can, through wise decisions, prevent a certain cancer from forming or spreading, that seems like a reasonable goal. None of us will live forever in this body, but if we can die of something other than cancer, that seems like a good goal too. May God give us wisdom to care for the body which He has given us.

“Waarom het ons nog nie ’n genesing vir kanker nie?” vroeg my pasiënt vir my.

Ek het met my skouers ‘n bietjie getrek. “Daar is baie verskillende soorte kanker,” het ek gesê. “Vir sommige is daar genesings, terwyl ons by ander steeds leer hoe om dit die beste te behandel.”

“Ek dink,” het my pasiënt gesê met die selfvertroue dat hy ’n topgeheime teorie deel, “ek dink daar is eintlik ’n genesing vir kanker, maar die geneesmiddelmaatskappye wil net nie hê ons moet daarvan weet nie.”

Ek het my kop geskud. “Ek dink ons doen die beste wat ons kan,” het ek vir hom gesê. “Ons het groot vordering gemaak met die behandeling van kanker, maar ons het nog ’n lang pad om te gaan.”

Kanker is ’n angswekkende siekte. ’n Christenman het vir my vertel dat hy nie bang was om te sterf nie, maar as hy ’n keuse gehad het, sou hy byna enige ander manier kies om te sterf eerder as aan kanker.

Meer as dit, dit is iets wat geheim voorkom. Dit lyk asof meer mense dit kry, tog weet niemand regtig hoekom nie.

In hierdie artikel wil ek ’n rukkie neem om te ondersoek wat kanker is, en om te bespreek wat ondersoekttoetse vir kanker behels. In die tweede deel (in die volgende uitgawe) sal ek, so God wil, sommige van die behandelings beskikbaar vir kankers bespreek.

Ek noem hier dat ek ’n huisarts is. Ek het vir baie pasiënte met kanker gesorg, maar ek is beslis nie ’n onkoloog nie, en ek weet nie alles oor kanker nie. Wat ek verstaan, is ek bereid om te deel.

Wat is Kanker?

Soos met baie dinge, kan ons die begin van kanker terugvoer na die val van die mens in die Tuin van Eden. Ons weet dat God die mens perfek geskep het. Soos oorspronklik geskape, het hulle nie net nie kanker gehad nie, maar hulle sou dit ook nie gekry het nie.

Om te verstaan wat kanker is, moet ons verstaan hoe normale weefsel en selle optree.

Normale selle leef vir ’n tydperk en sterf dan. Hierdie proses word apoptose genoem. Dit verseker dat daar ’n konstante omset van selle is. Dit voorkom ook dat een soort sel “uit lyn” raak en begin groei op ’n plek waar dit nie hoort nie.

Elke keer as ons selle deel, kopieer hulle hul DNA in die dogterselle. Gewoonlik gebeur dit sonder fout, maar soms is daar ’n fout in die kopieerproses. Ons noem hierdie foute mutasies.

Kankerselle is selle wat die normale remme op hul gedrag verloor het. As gevolg van mutasies in hul DNA het hulle nie meer ’n beperkte leeftyd nie, en hulle hou ook nie by die grense van waar hulle in die liggaam behoort nie. In plaas daarvan begin hulle in omliggende weefsels inkruip en trek intussen ekstra bloedtoevoer en voedingstowwe aan.

Kankerselle kan plaaslik vergroot, of hulle kan deur die limfatiese stelsel of die bloedsomloop na verre dele van die liggaam versprei. Wanneer kankerselle op ander plekke eindig as waar hulle ontstaan het, noem ons dit metastase.

Die tipe kanker word bepaal deur die tipe sel wat uit beheer vermeerder. Dokters praat gewoonlik nie net van “huidkanker” nie, alhoewel daar kankers is wat in huidselle ontstaan. In plaas daarvan klassifiseer hulle hierdie kankers as basaal-sel-karsinoom, skuimige-sel-karsinoom en melanoom—elkeen verwysend na ’n ander soort huidsel. Elk van hierdie huidselle-kankers tree anders op. Basaal-sel-karsinoom en skuimige-sel-karsinoom groei in ’n plaaslike area en versprei selde elders, terwyl melanoom baie geneig is om na ander dele van die liggaam te versprei.

Daarbenewens sal hoe ’n kanker op behandeling reageer gebaseer wees op die tipe sel waaruit dit kom, nie slegs op die orgaan waar dit ontstaan het nie.

Oorsake van Mutasies…

Ons weet nie hoe algemeen kanker was in die dae voor die vloed nie. Ek sou raai dat dit redelik skaars was.

Ons weet dat mense voor die vloed baie oud geword het—dikwels in hul 900s. Mutasies moes skaars gewees het. Hul DNA was nader aan die oorspronklike genetiese spesimen van die mensdom (en dus nader aan volmaaktheid) as onsne in die 21st eeu (n.C.). Daarom was die kans dat gene muteer en abnormale gene verskyn, veel minder as wat dit nou is.

…Omgewingsfaktore

Daarbenewens moes iets rondom die tyd van die vloed gebeur het wat die tempo van mutasies verhoog het. Miskien was daar ’n toename in bestralingvlakke. Miskien was daar genetiese veranderings wat geleidelik veroorsaak het dat kanker na vore gekom het.

Kanker word nie in die Bybel genoem nie, alhoewel dit moontlik is dat Hiskia se “sweer” ’n soort kankeragtige groei kon gewees het. Dit is ook moontlik dat sommige van die siektes wat die Filistyne gepla het toe die ark van die verbond in hul land was, kankeragtige gewasse was.

Mense het korter ná die vloed gesterf en by die tyd van Abraham het hulle selde baie ver oor die honderdste jaar geleef.

Vandag weet ons dat dinge wat die sel se kopieermeganisme en sy DNA beskadig, die risiko vir kanker verhoog. Die bekendste hiervan is bestraling.

Na die ontploffing van die atoombomme oor Hiroshima en Nagasaki is daar by oorlewendes opmerklike verhogings in sekere soorte kanker waargeneem. Leukemie (kanker van die bloed) was die algemeenste tipe kanker, gevolg deur kanker van die maag, longe, lewer en bors.

Bestraling is nie iets waarmee die meeste mense gereeld te doen het nie. Maar as jy in ’n röntgendiftdepartment werk of as jy bestraling moes kry om ’n tipe kanker te behandel, is dit moontlik dat jy aan baie hoër vlakke van bestraling blootgestel is as die algemene publiek.

Daar is baie ander dinge wat geassosieer word met ’n toename in kankers. Blootstelling aan ultravioletlig verhoog die risiko van huidkanker en is ’n groot rede waarom dokters sonskerm en beskermende klere aanbeveel terwyl mens die son geniet, om ultravioletblootstelling te beperk.

Laastens is daar baie chemikalieë wat in verskillende tipes werk voorkom en die risiko van kanker kan verhoog.

…Ongesonde Kosse

Kosse wat hoog is in nitriete verhoog die risiko van ingewandskankers. Nitriete is tipies in gerookte en gebraaide/gekruide vleis teenwoordig. Om gesond te wees, behoort mense dus hul inname van hierdie kosse te beperk tot geen, of ten minste ’n baie beperkte persentasie van die algehele dieet nie.

…Sekere Vorige Siektes

’n Ander ding om te noem is dat sekere tipes infeksies die risiko van kanker kan verhoog. Epstein-Barr-virus, wat infektieuse mononukleose veroorsaak, is geassosieer met sekere soorte limfoom. Hepatitis B en C verhoog die risiko van hepatosellulêre karsinoom (lewerkanker). En Helicobacter pylori-infeksies in die maag word geassosieer met maagkankers.

Dit is belangrik om te onthou dat net omdat iemand een van hierdie virusse gehad het, dit nie noodwendig beteken dat hulle kanker van daardie infeksie sal kry nie. Dit verhoog bloot die risiko dat die persoon wat besmet is, op ’n stadium in die toekoms kanker sal hê.

…Ongesonde Gewoontes

’n Laaste ding om te noem is dat sekere gifstowwe die risiko van kanker dramaties verhoog. ’n Voor die hand liggende een is tabakgebruik, wat die risiko van longkanker, keel- en selfs blaas-kanker sterk verhoog. Alkohol is ’n ander risikofaktor. Alkohol verhoog die risiko van mond- en keel-kankers, gastro-intestinale kankers en lewerkanker. Daar is regtig geen veilige hoeveelheid blootstelling aan enige van hierdie giftige middels nie, maar hoe groter die vlak van blootstelling, hoe erger is dit sekerlik.

Sifting vir Kanker

Daar is baie toetse beskikbaar wat beweer dat hulle kan sift vir ’n verskeidenheid kankers. Die meeste van hulle is ten minste ’n bietjie effektief om kankers in ’n vroeë stadium te identifiseer. Daar is egter ’n paar probleme met sommige van hulle wat aandui dat ’n bepaalde toets nie werklik doeltreffend is om by die sifting te help nie.

’n Goeie plek om te begin is om bloot te dink aan hoe ’n perfekte siftingstoets sou lyk. Dit sal ons help om te sien waar toetse nuttig kan wees of nie.

’n Perfekte siftingstoets sal ’n aantal kenmerke hê. Eerstens sal dit geen vals positiewe of vals negatiewe uitslae hê nie. Met ander woorde, almal wat positief toets sal kanker hê en dié wat negatief toets sal nie kanker hê nie. Verder sal die toets die kanker op ’n punt identifiseer wat vroeg genoeg in sy ontwikkeling is dat dit maklik is om te behandel. Die toets sal goedkoop en minimaal indringend wees, en dit sal minimale blootstelling aan bestraling vereis.

Ongelukkig voldoen geen toets wat ons tans vir sifting gebruik, totaal aan hierdie kriteria nie.

Vir een ding lewer baie toetse beide vals positiewe en vals negatiewe uitslae op. Dit is albei probleme. Die kwessie met ’n vals negatiewe toets is duidelik—dit laat iemand dink hulle het nie kanker nie wanneer hulle dit regtig wel het. ’n Vals positiewe toets daarenteen veroorsaak groter angsvlakke tesame met die koste en gevare van watter verdere toetse ook al nodig is om ’n pasiënt te laat weet dat hulle eintlik nie kanker het nie.

’n Voorbeeld van ’n swak toets, in hierdie opsig, is die CEA-125. CEA-125 is ’n chemikalie wat deur sekere tipes kanker gemaak word. Onkoloë gebruik hierdie vlak om ’n pasiënt se reaksie op chemoterapie te volg.

Dit sou sin maak dat jy dit as ’n siftingstoets vir hierdie kankers sou kon gebruik, maar dit werk eenvoudig nie. Baie mense het verhoogde CEA-vlakke, al het hulle nie kanker nie en aan die ander kant maak baie GI (gastro-intestinale) kankers hierdie chemikalie glad nie. Om baie mense met CEA-125 te toets sal tot meer skanderings en biopsies lei, maar dit is betwyfelbaar of dit ’n beduidende invloed op sterftetalle van kanker sou hê.

’n Ander kwessie het te make met die bepaalde kanker self. Vir ’n toets om nuttig te wees, moet die kanker ’n lang voortgang hê deur voor-kankerstadia totdat dit uiteindelik ontwikkel in volgewas- kanker.

’n Voorbeeld is dikderm-kanker. Die meeste mense wat dikdermkanker ontwikkel, het voor-kankerse poliepe verskeie jare voordat hulle die kanker kry. Dit is waarom kolonoskopieë effektief kan wees om die ontwikkeling na dikdermkanker te voorkom.

As ’n pasiënt ’n kolonoskopie het, kan die dokter die teenwoordigheid van poliepe opspoor. Meer as dit, kan hy die poliepe deur die skoop verwyder, hopelik die voortgang na kanker stop.

’n Laaste, verwante punt is dat daar ’n voordeel van vroeë opsporing moet wees. As ’n nuwe toets kanker ses maande vroeër kan opspoor as bestaande toetse, sal mense gemiddelde ses maande langer met die kanker leef as voorheen, selfs al verander niks anders nie.

Die vraag is of die diagnose van die kanker vroeër tot meer effektiewe behandeling lei. Kan jy dit uitneem voordat dit na die limfkliere versprei en sodoende die behoefte aan chemoterapie heeltemal vermy?

As behandelings- en reaksietariewe dieselfde is ongeag die stadium waarin jy ’n kanker diagnoseer, maak sifting regtig nie sin nie.

Die United States Preventive Services Task Force is ’n vrywillige paneel van kundiges wat die literatuur oor ’n verskeidenheid toetse hersien het. Gebaseer op die studies wat uitgevoer is oor die beskikbare toetse, gee hulle aanbevelings oor die verskillende toetse en hoe gereeld om dit te gebruik.

Hierdie paneel neig om in hul aanbevelings konserwatiewer te wees as baie kankersameleweings. Byvoorbeeld, hulle beveel elkeen twee jaar die gebruik van mammogramme aan vir vroue tussen die ouderdomme van 50 en 75, in vergelyking met die jaarlikse sifting wat deur ander groepe aanbeveel word.

By elke aanbeveling gee hulle ’n graad van hoe goed die studies is wat daardie spesifieke aanbeveling ondersteun, tesame met skakels na daardie studies. Hul aanbevelings is goed nagevors. Dit is nuttig vir lae-risiko mense wat probeer besluit watter toetse om te doen. As iemand ’n hoë risiko het as gevolg van familiegeskiedenis of blootstellings, is hul aanbevelings minder nuttig.

Kanker-uitdagings

Mense bespreek dikwels kanker asof dit ’n enkele entiteit was. Soos reeds genoem, is kanker nie net een ding nie. Huidkanker tree anders op as limfoom, wat op sy beurt anders optree as sarkome. Die kans dat daar ooit ’n enkele behandeling vir alle kankers sal wees—die “Genesing vir Kanker” waarna mense verwys, is onwaarskynlik.

’n Nog groter uitdaging by die hantering van kankerselle is dat hulle baie soortgelyk is aan ons normale selle. Basies probeer ons die kanker net ’n bietjie meer vergiftig as die res van ons normale weefsels. Daar is ’n aantal verskillende behandelings wat tans beskikbaar is. In Deel 2 sal ons sommige van die verskillende opsies wat vandag beskikbaar is en sommige ander wat in die toekoms moontlik beskikbaar sal wees, bespreek.

Laaste Gedagtes

Daar is ’n paar dinge wat by my opkom wanneer ek oor die onderwerp kanker nadink.

Ons hoef nie in vrees te lewe of besluite uit vrees te neem nie. Vrees jy nie; want Ek is met jou: wees nie verslae nie; want Ek is jou God: Ek sal jou versterk; ja, Ek sal jou help; ja, Ek sal jou ondersteun met die regterhand van my geregtigheid – Jesaja 41:10.

Ek dink nie ons moet fatalisties enige ding toelaat wat mag gebeur, bloot omdat dit “God se wil” is nie. Ons moet wyse keuses maak, en nadat ons dit gedoen het, moet ons nie in ’n toestand van angs lewe nie.

Moenie julle dus besorg maak en sê: Wat sal ons eet? of: Wat sal ons drink? of: Waarmee sal ons beklee word? (Want na al hierdie dinge soek die heidene:) want julle hemelse Vader weet dat julle dit alles nodig het. Maar soek eerste die koninkryk van God en sy geregtigheid; en al hierdie dinge sal by julle gevoeg word. Wees dus nie bekommerd oor die dag van môre nie: want die dag van môre sal sorg vir die dinge daarvan. Elke dag het genoeg aan sy eie boosheid – Matteus 6:31-34.

Ten slotte, as ons deur wyse besluite ’n sekere kanker kan voorkom om te vorm of te versprei, lyk dit na ’n redelike doel. Geen van ons sal vir ewig in hierdie liggaam lewe nie, maar as ons aan iets anders as kanker kan sterf, lyk dit ook na ’n goeie doel. Mag God ons wysheid gee om te sorg vir die liggaam wat Hy ons gegee het.

Over the last number of years, we have spent much of our time in Haiti serving on the mission field. From time to time, we would return to America for visits of varying lengths and reasons. Each trip back to the U.S. has been challenging as we have observed the changes—changes in culture, in technology, in values, etc. Sometimes, as our family looks at our country, it seems as if there is little hope. Clearly evil is taking control. However, to me the change that seems to be the most concerning is that of the church. Most, if not all, God-fearing Christians clearly see the moral decline of our land, but what about our churches? Is the church holding firm to biblical teaching or is it following the world in gradual change and compromise?

Overall, the American church seems to be thriving financially. Our businesses are improving, along with our standard of living, while spiritually, many Christians seem to be losing their zeal for godliness. What will the church look like in 40, 50, or 80 years?

When we read the book of Acts, we see something over and over. God’s power is revealed, and souls are added to the kingdom—daily.

Usually, when people see something that they need, they go after it. When they see something that they are sure that they must have, they can even become desperate or radical as they pursue a way to get that thing.

Jesus tells the parable of a field containing a lost or hidden treasure—Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field –Matthew 13:44.

Here you have a man that may be satisfied with his life. He has possessions and good health. As he is walking home, he sees something that he has never seen before, something of great value, something that he must have. No one needed to force him to take action. Also, it didn’t take days or weeks before he acted—he saw it and decided that he must have it immediately. So, he went and sold all that he had. (Selling ‘most’ would not buy the field. No, he must sell all.) After he buys the field, he now possesses the most important thing in the world. He will keep it forever, he will never part with it, no matter the cost. He also realizes that this treasure is not only good for him, but for all mankind. In fact, he soon understands that if he does not find this treasure, then sell all that he has, and purchase the treasure, he will perish—forever. People around him may not understand him—his actions, his decisions, his moves—they may be confused at first, as to why he did what he did. However, they will not be confused about one thing—this treasure was worth all the world to this man. His love for it cannot be denied.

This man now possesses something within himself out of which flows love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance… –Galatians 5:22-23, which is the fruit of the Spirit. He seems to have a special power about him. He overcomes suffering and difficulties with ease—at least that’s how it appears to those looking on. He holds no grudges and loves even his enemies. Truly this man has found something for which it is worth selling all. Then, lo and behold, others begin to sell what they have, to possess this treasure for themselves also.

According to the Bible, God’s people are expected to be the light of the world and the salt of the earth. Let’s seriously and honestly ask ourselves this question: “Do those around us experience us as biblical light and salt?!”

During the time of the Acts of the Apostles, there were clear lines, and the church grew. Yes, it suffered; however, it still grew, at times daily.

As I travel to different communities, I see something that is hard to understand. There are certain groups of people that seem to look different from the world around them, but still, they seem to act the same as mainstream America. Their interests are the same; their desires are the same. I have wondered why they continue to look different from the world while they seem to have the same values.

I was in a grocery store when a woman that I had never seen before approached me. She was very cheerful and asked me some random questions, then before she left, she said, “I love you Mennonites; you are so cute!” It was heart-breaking—we did not cause conviction in her heart. We did not even set an example for her. Instead, we were simply entertaining her.

In Haiti, my family would walk into a church or a spiritual gathering, and the ladies would pull at their miniskirts, trying desperately to cover their nakedness. I’ve even seen some remove their jewelry, without us speaking a word! Light exposes darkness: it brings conviction. That is why Christians used to be hated by those around them.

So why are we a cultural display to the world? What has changed? Could it be that we are simply reproducing the cultural norms that the world holds dear? Are we leaving God out, while we continue to do the things this world has come to accept?

When Nicodemus came to Jesus, he instantly began to lift up the Lord saying …we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him –John 3:2.

However, Jesus seems to ignore these words and He cuts right to the chase, when He says: …Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God –John 3:3. It’s almost as if He was saying, [“Although you come seeking, you seem to possess some truth, and you are a ruler of the Jews, but the first thing that you must know is this: You must be born again.”] Powerful words. He then goes on to state the obvious—That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit –John 3:6.

Today we try to hide behind our flesh (our unregenerated human nature). We are good at blaming our shortcomings on the fact that we are in the flesh; some go as far as to say we are all sinners and therefore, we can do nothing but fail. However, here Jesus says that that which is flesh is flesh, and that which is spirit is spirit! Oh, that we could grasp the simplicity in these profound words! Flesh is flesh, not spirit. And spirit is spirit, not flesh. We are born with an adamic nature (a bent towards doing evil) from our mother’s womb. The prophet Jeremiah tells us that The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it? –Jeremiah 17:9. He goes on to explain: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins… –Jeremiah 17:10.

We may try, like the masses, to tame our human nature with all of its desires and passions. We may practice and prepare; we can groom the flesh in a certain way that seems good unto us. However, there is no hope, for in the flesh we cannot please God. So, according to Jesus we must be born again. Nicodemus asks: …How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born? –John 3:4.

Jesus then profoundly preaches a sermon to him, stating how there must be death …as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up –John 3:14.

Jesus goes on to say …every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved –John 3:20. If we must first die, to be born again, how do we die? And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts –Galatians 5:24. So how does a sincerely seeking person practically become “born again”?

  • That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved… –Romans 10:9-10.
  • Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost –Acts 2:38.
  • …the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it –Hebrews 4:2.
  • But without faith it is impossible to please him… –Hebrews 11:6.
  • And he came … preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins –Luke 3:3.
  • I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved… –John 10:9.
  • …Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me… –Mark 8:34-35.
  • Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me –Revelation 3:20.
  • …And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee. And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him –John 9:35-38.
  • For by grace are ye saved through faith … it is the gift of God: Not of works… –Ephesians 2:8-9.

Here we see that there are various aspects of becoming, of being, and of remaining born again. We have faith that is full and unwavering. We need to have faith in the God of the Bible—The great I AM, THAT I AM. Our faith must be open to those around us—we must not keep it hidden. We must not allow the fear of man to keep our faith in God quiet. We need to start walking in repentance. We need to seek baptism unto repentance for the remission of sins. We need to see Jesus as the door—the only way to God through which we must enter and then walk in righteousness. We need to see Jesus’ death on the cross as the gift of God to us for salvation. And as we see God for who He is and Jesus, His Son, for who He is, then we must worship. All of these (and others) are a part of becoming born again, or it is the outworking thereof, which continues to perpetuate the process of staying born again.

Are true conversions still happening in our day—are people being born again the way that Jesus was explaining to Nicodemus? We mock the prayer of the cheap-grace gospel, we look down on the powerless altar calls, but what are we doing about our need? We need to crucify the flesh. We need to live no longer unto self. And we need to be born again by the spirit of God. After spending time at the feet of Jesus, learning of Him and His Father and Their ways, we then need to go forth with Holy Spirit power to share with lost and struggling souls what God has done for us. As people see our life that has been changed by God, He will draw the souls that are seeking into the kingdom of His dear Son.

If we are truly born again, we will have the same testimony and passion as the disciples. We will grow in grace and understanding. We will allow God to be God and His Word to be the Truth—final and complete! We will stop trying to reform the goats among us. Rather we will share the Gospel message with them so they can become converted—they will then be sheep with hearts of flesh instead of hearts of stone. A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh. And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them –Ezekiel 36:26-27.

So why is there a lack of truly born-again believers among us? I believe this world has captivated us. We look for compromise wherever we can. Sure, we will dress a little differently if we must, but don’t take away all our pleasure and fun. We fill our lives with everything this sin-sick world has to offer—money, entertainment, luxury, vacations, food, and drink, then when we walk by the field with the treasure hidden in it, we do not even notice it. It’s there, simply forgotten.

When we sing the songs of Zion and pray the prayers of petition and praise, is God at work? Is there an everlasting joy in our hearts or are we tossed about by the storms of life? Are we out trying to help the blind to see or are we trying to conceal the fact that we’re Christians?!

Let’s put an end to this defeated Christian life that knows little of victory. Let’s put an end to the lukewarm living that’s accepted by the masses around us! Let’s put an end to loving this present evil world! Let’s put an end to individualism and self! Let’s put on the Lord Jesus Christ and together march out to battle against the enemy of our souls. Enough of just sitting at home singing the songs; let’s go out and fight for that which so many before us have fought. We read about it in our church history books. We glean encouragement and insight from our Bibles and our copies of the Martyrs Mirror. But what will future generations say about us? Will there be any godly testimonies written about us?

The Bible is full of promises:

  • Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you… –Matthew 7:7-8.
  • …God … will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it –1 Corinthians 10:13.
  • …If ye have faith, and doubt not … ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done –Matthew 21:21.
  • This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh –Galatians 5:16.

And the list goes on! Are these a part of our lives? Are we living in victory, or are we hiding behind a failed culture with no power?

Dear ones, God wants a people to call His own today just as much as He did in the beginning. He wants us! It is a sobering thought. God wants to raise us up by His Spirit, He wants to breathe into us His breath—the Breath of Life. He wants to bless us with spiritual blessings that cannot be fathomed!

However, the old man must die—his pride, his name, his attitude, his fame. The old man must give way for the new; they cannot live together in the same body. According to scripture, it’s one or the other. One will die, and one will live—forever!

Let’s not allow the serpent (or the devil) to deceive us any longer. The pleasures of this life are only for a moment. We reap what we sow; we will not escape the Judgment. God wants to give us the Kingdom; He wants to give us the inheritance. He wants to be a father to us, to call us His dear children. He wants to walk with us through this narrow way. He wants to encourage us when we are down, and He wants to fight for us when we are weak. He wants to give us an identity, a part of the family of God—His children. He wants to give us power to overcome all sin (not just some), today and tomorrow and for the rest of our life. When we fail, He wants to give us a desire to repent. Then when we accept that desire and move back towards Him, He wants to forgive us.

The darker this world gets, the easier the light should shine. Are we, through the Spirit, that lighthouse standing tall in the face of the storm? The wind and the waves beat against it, but it cannot be moved. Its light shines through the darkest times, giving hope to the weary souls stranded in life. Its foundation does not move; its purpose does not change.

We can fill our heads with knowledge and know all the right things to say and do. However, if we are not quickened by the Spirit of God, we are simply a culture that will change with each generation. This change will continue until the last generation has been fully submerged in the seas of this world. All the while, the destroyer of our souls gains more for himself.

This battle is real—some will win, many will lose. The loss is great, greater than I can describe; and so is the win.

Twenty first century Christian, what will you do?

Nestes últimos anos, passamos grande parte do nosso tempo no Haiti servindo no campo missionário. De vez em quando, voltávamos aos Estados Unidos para visitas de durações e motivos variados. Cada viagem de volta aos EUA tem sido desafiadora à medida que observamos as mudanças—mudanças na cultura, na tecnologia, nos valores, etc. Às vezes, quando nossa família olha para o nosso país, parece que há pouca esperança. Claramente o mal está tomando controle. Porém, para mim a mudança que parece mais preocupante é a da igreja. A maioria, se não todos, os cristãos tementes a Deus claramente vêem o declínio moral da nossa terra, mas e quanto às nossas igrejas? A igreja está mantendo firme o ensino bíblico ou está seguindo o mundo, em mudança e compromisso graduais?

No geral, a igreja americana parece estar prosperando financeiramente. Nossos negócios estão melhorando, juntamente com nosso padrão de vida, enquanto espiritualmente muitos cristãos parecem estar perdendo o zelo pela piedade. Como será a igreja em 40, 50 ou 80 anos?

Quando lemos o livro de Atos, vemos algo repetidas vezes. O poder de Deus é revelado, e almas são acrescentadas ao reino—diariamente.

Geralmente, quando as pessoas veem algo de que precisam, elas correm atrás. Quando veem algo que têm certeza de que devem possuir, podem até ficar desesperadas ou radicais ao perseguir um modo de obter aquilo.

Jesus conta a parábola de um campo que contém um tesouro perdido ou escondido—Outra vez, o reino dos céus é semelhante a um tesouro escondido num campo; o qual, achando-o um homem, esconde-o, e, por causa da alegria, vai, vende tudo quanto tem e compra aquele campo –Mateus 13:44.

Aqui tens um homem que talvez esteja satisfeito com sua vida. Tem posses e boa saúde. Enquanto caminha para casa, vê algo que nunca tinha visto antes, algo de grande valor, algo que ele deve possuir. Ninguém precisou forçá-lo a agir. Além disso, não demorou dias ou semanas antes de agir—ele viu e decidiu que devia tê-lo imediatamente. Assim, foi e vendeu tudo o que tinha. (Vender “a maior parte” não compraria o campo. Não, ele deve vender tudo.) Depois de comprar o campo, ele agora possui a coisa mais importante do mundo. Guardará para sempre, nunca se separará dela, não importa o custo. Também percebe que esse tesouro não é apenas bom para ele, mas para toda a humanidade. De fato, logo entende que se não encontrar esse tesouro, vender tudo o que tem e comprar o tesouro, perecerá—para sempre. As pessoas ao redor podem não entendê-lo—suas ações, suas decisões, seus passos—podem ficar confusas no começo quanto ao motivo de ele ter feito o que fez. Contudo, não ficarão confusas quanto a uma coisa—este tesouro valeu todo o mundo para esse homem. Seu amor por ele não pode ser negado.

Esse homem agora possui algo dentro de si do qual fluem amor, gozo, paz, longanimidade, benignidade, bondade, fidelidade, mansidão, domínio próprio… –Gálatas 5:22-23, que é o fruto do Espírito. Parece haver um poder especial ao redor dele. Supera o sofrimento e as dificuldades com facilidade—pelo menos é assim que aparenta aos que olham. Não guarda rancores e ama até mesmo seus inimigos. Verdadeiramente esse homem encontrou algo pelo qual valeu vender tudo. Então, veem outros começar a vender o que têm, para possuir esse tesouro por si mesmos também.

Segundo a Bíblia, o povo de Deus é esperado para ser a luz do mundo e o sal da terra. Perguntemo-nos seriamente e com honestidade: “Aqueles ao nosso redor nos experimentam como luz e sal bíblicos?!”

Durante o tempo dos Atos dos Apóstolos, havia linhas claras, e a igreja crescia. Sim, sofria; contudo, ainda crescia, por vezes diariamente.

Ao viajar para diferentes comunidades, vejo algo difícil de entender. Existem certos grupos de pessoas que parecem ter aparência diferente do mundo ao seu redor, mas ainda assim parecem agir como a América mainstream. Seus interesses são os mesmos; seus desejos são os mesmos. Tenho me perguntado por que continuam a parecer diferentes do mundo enquanto parecem ter os mesmos valores.

Estava num supermercado quando uma mulher que eu nunca tinha visto antes se aproximou de mim. Estava muito alegre e me fez algumas perguntas aleatórias, então, antes de ir-se, disse: “Eu amo vocês, menonitas; vocês são tão fofos!” Foi de cortar o coração—não causamos convicção em seu coração. Não demos sequer um exemplo a ela. Em vez disso, estávamos simplesmente a entretê-la.

No Haiti, minha família entrava numa igreja ou numa reunião espiritual, e as senhoras puxavam suas minissaias, tentando desesperadamente cobrir sua nudez. Cheguei a ver algumas retirarem suas joias, sem nós dizermos uma palavra! A luz expõe as trevas: traz convicção. Por isso os cristãos costumavam ser odiados pelos que os rodeavam.

Então por que somos uma exibição cultural para o mundo? O que mudou? Poderia ser que estamos simplesmente reproduzindo as normas culturais que o mundo estima? Estamos deixando Deus de fora, enquanto continuamos a fazer as coisas que este mundo passou a aceitar?

Quando Nicodemos veio a Jesus, começou imediatamente a exaltar o Senhor dizendo …sabemos que tu és mestre vindo de Deus; porque ninguém pode fazer estes sinais que tu fazes, se Deus não for com ele –João 3:2.

No entanto, Jesus parece ignorar essas palavras e vai direto ao ponto, quando diz: …Na verdade, na verdade te digo que, se alguém não nascer de novo, não pode ver o reino de Deus –João 3:3. É quase como se estivesse dizendo, [“Embora venhas buscando, e pareças possuir alguma verdade, e sejas um príncipe dos judeus, a primeira coisa que deves saber é isto: Tens de nascer de novo.”] Palavras poderosas. Em seguida, vai ao óbvio—Aquilo que é nascido da carne é carne; e aquilo que é nascido do Espírito é espírito –João 3:6.

Hoje tentamos nos esconder atrás da nossa carne (a nossa natureza humana não regenerada). Somos bons em atribuir nossas deficiências ao fato de estarmos na carne; alguns chegam ao ponto de dizer que todos somos pecadores e, portanto, nada podemos senão falhar. Contudo, aqui Jesus diz que aquilo que é carne é carne, e aquilo que é espírito é espírito! Oh, que pudéssemos compreender a simplicidade dessas palavras profundas! Carne é carne, não é espírito. E espírito é espírito, não é carne. Nascemos com uma natureza adâmica (uma inclinação para o mal) desde o ventre de nossa mãe. O profeta Jeremias nos diz que O coração é mais enganoso que todas as coisas e desesperadamente corrupto; quem o conhecerá? –Jeremias 17:9. Ele prossegue explicando: Eu, o SENHOR, esquadrinho o coração e provo os pensamentos –Jeremias 17:10.

Poderemos tentar, como as massas, domesticar nossa natureza humana com todos os seus desejos e paixões. Podemos praticar e nos preparar; podemos aparar a carne de certa maneira que nos parece boa. Entretanto, não há esperança, pois na carne não podemos agradar a Deus. Assim, segundo Jesus, devemos nascer de novo. Nicodemos pergunta: …Como pode um homem nascer sendo velho? Porventura pode tornar a entrar no ventre de sua mãe e nascer? –João 3:4.

Jesus então profere uma pregação profunda a ele, declarando como deve haver morte …assim como Moisés levantou a serpente no deserto, assim importa que o Filho do homem seja levantado –João 3:14.

Jesus continua dizendo …todo aquele que faz o mal odeia a luz, e não vem a luz, para que as suas obras não sejam reprovadas –João 3:20. Se primeiro devemos morrer para nascer de novo, como morremos? E os que são de Cristo crucificaram a carne com as suas paixões e concupiscências –Gálatas 5:24. Então, como uma pessoa que busca sinceramente torna-se, na prática, “nascida de novo”?

  • Que, se com a tua boca confessares Jesus como Senhor, e em teu coração creres que Deus o ressuscitou dentre os mortos, serás salvo… –Romanos 10:9-10.
  • E disse-lhes Pedro: Arrependei-vos, e cada um de vós seja batizado em nome de Jesus Cristo, para remissão dos pecados; e recebereis o dom do Espírito Santo –Atos 2:38.
  • …a palavra pregada não lhes serviu de proveito, por não ter sido misturada com fé nos que a ouviram –Hebreus 4:2.
  • Mas sem fé é impossível agradar-lhe… –Hebreus 11:6.
  • E veio pregando o batismo de arrependimento para remissão dos pecados –Lucas 3:3.
  • Eu sou a porta; se alguém entrar por mim, será salvo… –João 10:9.
  • …Se alguém quer vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, e tome cada dia a sua cruz, e siga-me… –Marcos 8:34-35.
  • Eis que estou à porta e bato; se alguém ouvir a minha voz e abrir a porta, entrarei em sua casa e cearei com ele, e ele comigo –Apocalipse 3:20.
  • …E Jesus lhe disse: Viste o Filho do Homem; e ele é que fala contigo. E ele disse: Senhor, creio. E o adorou –João 9:35-38.
  • Porque pela graça sois salvos, mediante a fé… e isto não vem de vós; é dom de Deus: não vem das obras… –Efésios 2:8-9.

Aqui vemos que há vários aspectos de tornar-se, de ser e de permanecer nascido de novo. Temos uma fé plena e inabalável. Precisamos ter fé no Deus da Bíblia—O grande EU SOU, AQUELE QUE SOU. Nossa fé deve ser manifesta aos que nos rodeiam—não a devemos manter oculta. Não devemos permitir que o medo do homem mantenha nossa fé em Deus em silêncio. Precisamos começar a andar em arrependimento. Precisamos buscar o batismo para arrependimento e remissão dos pecados. Precisamos ver Jesus como a porta—a única via para Deus pela qual devemos entrar e então andar em justiça. Precisamos ver a morte de Jesus na cruz como o dom de Deus para nossa salvação. E, ao ver a Deus por quem Ele é e Jesus, Seu Filho, por quem Ele é, devemos então adorá-los. Tudo isto (e outras coisas) faz parte de tornar-se nascido de novo, ou é o desdobrar disso, que continua a perpetuar o processo de permanecer nascido de novo.

Acontecimentose verdadeiras conversões ainda nos dias de hoje—estão as pessoas nascendo de novo da forma que Jesus explicou a Nicodemos? Nós zombamos da oração do evangelho da graça barata, desprezamos os chamados de altar sem poder, mas o que estamos fazendo sobre nossa necessidade? Precisamos crucificar a carne. Precisamos não mais viver para nós mesmos. E precisamos nascer de novo pelo Espírito de Deus. Depois de passar tempo aos pés de Jesus, aprendendo dEle e de Seu Pai e de Seus caminhos, então precisamos sair com o poder do Espírito Santo para compartilhar com almas perdidas e em luta o que Deus fez por nós. À medida que as pessoas vêem nossa vida transformada por Deus, Ele atrairá as almas que estão buscando para o reino de Seu amado Filho.

Se formos realmente nascidos de novo, teremos o mesmo testemunho e paixão que os discípulos. Cresceremos em graça e entendimento. Permitir-nos-emos que Deus seja Deus e Sua Palavra seja a Verdade—final e completa! Cessaremos de tentar reformar os bodes entre nós. Antes, compartilharemos a mensagem do Evangelho com eles para que possam ser convertidos—tornar-se-ão então ovelhas com corações de carne em vez de corações de pedra. Também vos darei um coração novo, e porei dentro de vós um espírito novo; e tirarei o coração de pedra da vossa carne, e vos darei um coração de carne. E porei o meu Espírito dentro de vós, e farei que andeis nos meus estatutos, e observeis os meus juízos, e os cumprais –Ezequiel 36:26-27.

Então por que há carência de crentes verdadeiramente nascidos de novo entre nós? Creio que este mundo nos cativou. Procuramos compromisso onde pudermos. Claro, vestiremos um pouco diferente se for preciso, mas não nos tirem todo o nosso prazer e divertimento. Enchemos nossas vidas com tudo o que este mundo doente de pecado tem a oferecer—dinheiro, entretenimento, luxo, férias, comida e bebida; então quando passamos pelo campo com o tesouro escondido nele, nem sequer o notamos. Está lá, simplesmente esquecido.

Quando cantamos os hinos de Sião e oramos as orações de petição e louvor, Deus está operando? Há uma alegria eterna em nossos corações ou somos sacudidos pelas tormentas da vida? Estamos tentando ajudar os cegos a ver ou tentando ocultar o fato de que somos cristãos?

Ponhamos fim a esta vida cristã derrotada que conhece pouco da vitória. Ponhamos fim a essa vida morna aceita pelas massas ao nosso redor! Ponhamos fim ao amor por este mundo presente e mau! Ponhamos fim ao individualismo e ao egoísmo! Revistamo-nos do Senhor Jesus Cristo e, juntos, marchemos para a batalha contra o inimigo de nossas almas. Basta de ficar em casa cantando as canções; saiamos e lutemos por aquilo pelo qual tantos antes de nós lutaram. Lejamos sobre isso em nossos livros de história da igreja. Colhemos ânimo e discernimento de nossas Bíblias e de nossas cópias do Martyrs Mirror. Mas o que dirão as gerações futuras sobre nós? Haverá algum testemunho piedoso escrito sobre nós?

A Bíblia está cheia de promessas:

  • Pedi, e dar-se-vos-á; buscai, e encontrareis; batei, e abrir-se-vos-á… –Mateus 7:7-8.
  • …Deus é fiel; não vos deixará tentar acima do que podeis, antes, com a tentação, dará também o escape, para que a possais suportar –1 Coríntios 10:13.
  • …Se vós tiverdes fé e não duvidardes… direis a este monte: Passa daqui para acolá, e ele passará; e tudo o que pedirdes, crendo, recebereis –Mateus 21:21.
  • Digo isto: andai no Espírito, e jamais satisfareis a concupiscência da carne –Gálatas 5:16.

E a lista continua! Isto faz parte de nossas vidas? Vivemos em vitória, ou estamos nos escondendo atrás de uma cultura fracassada sem poder?

Amados, Deus quer um povo para chamar de seu hoje tanto quanto quis no princípio. Ele nos quer! É um pensamento sóbrio. Deus quer nos levantar pelo Seu Espírito, quer soprar em nós Seu fôlego—o Sopro de Vida. Quer nos abençoar com bênçãos espirituais que não podem ser compreendidas!

No entanto, o homem velho deve morrer—seu orgulho, seu nome, sua atitude, sua fama. O homem velho deve dar lugar ao novo; não podem viver juntos no mesmo corpo. Segundo as Escrituras, é uma ou outra. Uma morrerá, e outra viverá—para sempre!

Não permitamos mais que a serpente (ou o diabo) nos engane. Os prazeres desta vida são apenas por um momento. Ceifamos o que semeamos; não escaparemos do Juízo. Deus quer nos dar o Reino; quer nos dar a herança. Quer ser pai para nós, nos chamar seus queridos filhos. Quer caminhar conosco por este caminho estreito. Quer nos encorajar quando estamos abatidos, e quer lutar por nós quando estamos fracos. Quer nos dar uma identidade, uma parte da família de Deus—Seus filhos. Quer nos dar poder para vencer todo pecado (não apenas parte), hoje e amanhã e pelo resto de nossa vida. Quando falharmos, quer nos dar desejo de nos arrepender. Então, quando aceitarmos esse desejo e voltarmos para Ele, quer nos perdoar.

Quanto mais escuro este mundo ficar, mais facilmente a luz deve brilhar. Somos nós, por meio do Espírito, aquele farol erguido diante da tempestade? O vento e as ondas batem contra ele, mas não pode ser movido. Sua luz brilha através dos tempos mais sombrios, dando esperança às almas cansadas e à deriva na vida. Sua fundação não se move; seu propósito não muda.

Podemos encher nossas cabeças com conhecimento e saber todas as coisas certas a dizer e a fazer. Entretanto, se não formos vivificados pelo Espírito de Deus, somos simplesmente uma cultura que mudará a cada geração. Essa mudança continuará até que a última geração seja totalmente submersa nos mares deste mundo. Enquanto isso, o destruidor de nossas almas ganha mais para si.

Esta batalha é real—alguns vencerão, muitos perderão. A perda é grande, maior do que posso descrever; e assim é a vitória.

Cristão do século vinte e um, o que farás?
